bio.text: John Liu is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 16, a seat he assumed on January 1, 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for re-election.

Carnegie Corporation of New York profiled him as a Great Immigrant, born in Taiwan, who served as the 43rd New York City comptroller from 2010 to 2013 and was the first Asian American to hold citywide office in New York.
Before that, the same profile says, he represented Flushing and northeast Queens in the New York City Council.
